item.title: "Diapräsentation" has moved
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
“Diapräsentation” has moved and is now part of Projektemacher.org . This makes it the first of my old Tumblr blogs to be migrated to Hugo .

The old Tumblr page will remain, since there may still be some links pointing to it…

item.title: About this blog
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Diapräsentationen was a project to fill the summer holidays of 2013 a little, which is why it has not been extended since the project was completed. Originally hosted on Tumblr , it moved to Projektemacher.de in the summer of 2020.

My other blogs

My other blogs are now listed on Projektemacher.org .

Colophon

This site was generated with Hugo . The theme is based on the Tumblr theme Observer by Zack Sultan .

item.title: Talk
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Another flea market find has slipped into my net. Apparently there were ready-made slide talks in the GDR, simply delivered as a set of slides and audio tapes. Plainly declared as mass propaganda. If you can say more about this, please write via the “Ask” function above. I would love to learn more about it…

Whether I will now go and acquire a tape recorder for this, I don’t know yet.

item.title: Even More Slides!
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
After a " mishap" on the part of my landlord’s property management brought me to the Göttingen recycling yard for the first time today, I can understand more and more the fascination for the supposedly old, for the “garbage”. So my collection now includes motifs on the theme of starting school, presumably from the early 90s. As well as the work of probably two photographers:

  • Travel pictures from Greece and the Alps, with an interest in aeroplanes, probably their own VW bus, the concrete bunkers emerging at the time, and massive overexposure. Hard to date, 70s or 80s
  • A similar period, though rather underexposed, family pictures

The former is of course particularly well suited for presenting text in front of it, the latter might be usable as an in-between image…

item.title: New Slides and Slide Mounts
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description: The slide enthusiast Thomas Heinemann has once again provided me with a set of slides. This time: “The Holy Land”. With beautiful excavation motifs that can surely be put to good use for a talk on software refurbishment some day — and along with it came a whole lot of empty mounts, into which I can now assemble better fixed compositions of text and images myself. Unfortunately I had another appointment and therefore couldn’t stay to finish watching the great movie “O Brother, Where Art Thou? ” with him.

item.title: Getting an Overview
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
The author received about 500 slides together with the projectors. How do you get an overview of them? How do you find the right motifs? Unfortunately there is only one way: look at all of them…

A setup made of a webcam and a projector lends itself to this, see below.

The next step is then to manage and tag the images in a suitable program.

The first choice was supposed to be Picasa — the Windows version also offers capture via webcam. Unfortunately it was not possible to make this version work with the webcam under Wine or VirtualBox . Under VirtualBox, a five-year-old bug stood in the way.

item.title: The Template
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description: The window of a slide mount has a size of 36mm x 24mm. To insert the foils from PowerPoint, a corresponding template is needed. The template below was created with InDesign — the PDF files that can be produced with PowerPoint fit nicely into it.

item.title: The Equipment
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
The working material has arrived: two projectors and about 500 slides! The projectors are a Braun Paximat and a Rollei P355 .

The Paximat is the older and thus more representative one, the Rollei “faster” and therefore well suited for viewing and cataloguing.

Special thanks at this point also go to the generous donor, the flea market expert and slide enthusiast Thomas Heinemann!

item.title: The Beginning
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Vacation! The right time to implement a few old ideas. My interior design has now been completed (wardrobe). So something a bit more daring — since the whole thing seems to work, it’s time to document the result.

The Idea

PowerPoint and projectors are no longer anything special these days. Impress? Well…

It’s time for something new again. And as always, when you’re lacking creativity, you simply reach for something old to suggest something new. With this tried-and-tested method, the author does not want to be an exception.

item.title: Privacy policy
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Privacy policy

Hosting

The hoster collects the following data transmitted by your browser in log files:

  • IP address
  • The address of the previously visited website (Referer [sic!] request header)
  • Date and time of the enquiry
  • Time zone difference to Greenwich Mean Time
  • Content of the request
  • HTTP status code
  • Amount of data transferred
  • Website from which the request originates
  • Information about the browser and operating system

This is necessary to display the website and to ensure stability and security. This corresponds to a legitimate interest within the meaning of Art. 6 para. 1 sentence 1 lit. f GDPR .
